text:
anya: quick sync - we're seeing three separate customer reports after the latest 0.12.x canary about ESM/CJS runtime mismatches and types resolving to the wrong entrypoint. putting notes here before I open a playbook PR.

chris: can you summarise the failures? small repros are helpful.

anya: 1) bun + edge customers get "Buffer is not defined" when importing the package in edge mode. 2) a server-side app using require() sees the SDK auth retry loop (infinite) on certain 401 transient flows. 3) TS users in a strict ESM project pick up dist/cjs/index.d.ts which mislabels default export shape.

leo: probable causes: for (1) we shipped Buffer usage at top-level and relied on node polyfills. for (2) many CJS consumers end up pulling a different fetch implementation (node-fetch) and cross-realm instanceof checks cause retry mis-detection. for (3) our build emits separate d.ts per target and tsc/tsserver sometimes picks the wrong one.

frank: concrete mitigations we've previously used:
- avoid Buffer at top-level, use globalThis.Buffer when available or web-crypto in edge build
- change retry logic to duck-type request/response instead of instanceof
- create single root index.d.ts that re-exports platform-specific types instead of separate .d.ts files

chris: agree. Also add a tiny cjs shim that safely imports esm default shape to prevent module.exports.default surprises. Example cjs wrapper: 
```js
// dist/cjs/index.js
const mod = require('../esm/index.js');
module.exports = mod && mod.__esModule ? mod.default : mod;
```
that helps old bundlers.

anya: on package.json layout - want to standardize our conditional exports to avoid tool confusion. proposal: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "edge": "./dist/edge/index.js"
  }
},
"main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
"module": "dist/esm/index.js",
"types": "dist/index.d.ts"
```
observations: older node ignores conditional types; top-level types helps editors. keep one canonical d.ts.

leo: for edge entry, ensure it's pure ESM, no top-level await, and uses globalThis.crypto/subtle where needed. add a small runtime detection helper: 
```js
const isEdge = typeof globalThis.fetch === 'function' && !process?.versions?.node;
```
but be careful with Bun where process exists but behaves differently. 

frank: CI + smoke matrix suggestions: run quick installs and basic require/import sanity in these: node-cjs, node-esm (node 18+), vite dev, cloudflare worker runner, bun latest. Also run a TSserver check in an example strict ESM tsconfig that imports via "import sdk from 'redwood-sdk'".

ci-bot: created issue #4825: "publish playbook: dual-build smoke matrix + edge export" and started canary 0.12.4-canary.

chris: action items I can take: change retry instanceof checks -> duck-typing (status, ok/headers/text/json), add cjs shim export, add small test harness for cross-realm Response via node-fetch in cjs.

leo: I'll own the edge build: produce dist/edge with web-crypto usage, ensure no Buffer at top-level, add README snippet about polyfills for older runtimes.

anya: I'll own types: create single dist/index.d.ts that re-exports types from platform-specific files and ensure package.json points to it. Also update CHANGELOG and migration note.

frank: let's also document the publish checklist: build esm, build cjs, build edge, generate unified d.ts, smoke matrix job, publish canary tagged, and verify with small sample apps in examples/. That'll live in devex/publish-playbook.md PR.

anya: thanks everyone. I'll post PR links here and add the smoke test job. planning to cut a canary later today after tiny fixes. :metal:
